options.name: 穹顶追光
options.prompt: Edit the supplied real Slay the Spire 2 combat screenshot to preview a new VFX for the ability 舞台正在等待着. Preserve the exact 1280x720 gameplay composition, waterfall backdrop, red-uniform Karen sprite at left (feet near x320 y475), red lattice promise tower behind her, huge stone monster at right, original HUD, health bars and hand. This is an in-engine VFX concept screenshot, not card art, not a new illustration of the game. VFX should occupy the character's left combat area and leave Karen's silhouette, tower and UI legible. Match the game's stylized 2D painterly art. Visible light should feel alive, physically placed and composited, with high-quality soft falloff and restrained bloom. Do not draw titles, labels, captions, diagrams, additional characters or panels. Do not add a small toy theater, freestanding red curtain wings, floating black stage lamps, nested rectangular frames or a box around the character. Direction A: GRAND THEATER FOLLOWSPOT PERFORMANCE. The existing battlefield itself becomes a grand theater stage through light only. Two dramatic, very tall warm ivory followspots descend diagonally from well above the top of the scene, crossing behind Karen then converging into a broad foreshortened oval of warm white light under her feet. Each beam has one dominant crisp illuminated edge and translucent dusty interior, not triangular solid yellow polygons. The central landing pool is a luminous lens-shaped theatrical gobo with a restrained scarlet inner ring, broken radial hatch marks and amber floor reflections. Light Karen with a subtle warm rim. At the peak of the ability trigger show an elegant narrow upward shower of golden stage dust, concentrated near her ankles and rising to shoulder level, about 30 tiny particles with varying focus and brightness. Four small distant white cone lights across the upper left give a sense of a vast stage rig outside frame; no drawn fixtures. Clear hierarchy: monumental beams, bright footlight pool, delicate airborne particles. No added physical platform. Dramatic stage presence, clean and theatrical, not magic spell circles, no runes.

options.name: 旋转舞台
options.prompt: Edit the supplied real Slay the Spire 2 combat screenshot to preview a new VFX for the ability 舞台正在等待着. Preserve the exact gameplay composition and camera, waterfall backdrop, red-uniform Karen sprite at left (feet near x320 y475 in the 1280x720 source), red lattice promise tower behind her, huge stone monster at right, original HUD, health bars and hand. This is an in-engine VFX concept screenshot, not card art, not a new illustration of the game. VFX should occupy the character's left combat area and leave Karen's silhouette, tower and UI legible. Match the game's stylized 2D painterly art. Do not draw titles, labels, captions, diagrams, additional characters or panels. Do not add freestanding curtain wings, floating black lamp cans, rectangular stage frames or a box around the character. Direction C: REVOLVING THEATER STAGE MACHINERY WITH FOOTLIGHTS. A large low circular scarlet performance stage materializes directly beneath Karen and the promise tower. It is not a tiny toy theatre: the stage is a broad confident foreshortened disc spanning about x95 to x585 in source coordinates, with only a shallow visible front edge, rich dark red lacquer floor and three offset concentric stage-turntable segments. Outer arcs are interrupted with small gold edge sections and seven bright miniature footlight points facing inward. The surface has clean large shapes, no ornate filigree or magic writing. Capture the dramatic instant of rotation: only the outside turntable segments carry short tangential red-gold light streaks and a few flying gold sparks; Karen and the existing tower remain perfectly crisp and stationary on the central disc. Thin, realistic warm white beams from high offscreen right converge on her upper body. A strong fan of six low narrow white theatrical light rays rises BEHIND her from the rear rim of the stage, with dark spaces between them, building a sculptural semicircular stage-light backdrop. The disc is grounded with a soft contact shadow. The effect feels like an enormous mechanical stage being summoned, mechanically precise, bold red-and-gold, with elegant active particles instead of lots of painted decoration. The stage front must stay above and behind health bar and all game UI.

Preserve the exact gameplay composition and camera, waterfall backdrop, red-uniform Karen sprite at left (feet near x320 y475 in the 1280x720 source), red lattice promise tower behind her, huge stone monster at right, original HUD, health bars and hand. This is an in-engine VFX concept screenshot, not card art, not a new illustration of the game. VFX should occupy the character's left combat area and leave Karen's silhouette, tower and UI legible. Match the game's stylized 2D painterly art. Do not draw titles, labels, captions, diagrams, additional characters or panels. Do not add freestanding curtain wings, floating black lamp cans, rectangular stage frames or a box around the character. Direction D: AN ASCENDING CURTAIN OF STARLIGHT, NO PHYSICAL SET. A spectacular asymmetric curtain of many slender warm-gold vertical light threads rises behind Karen, starting at floor height and sweeping in a curved wave toward upper left. Threads are spaced unevenly with visible dark gaps and fade out at different heights, giving the impression that a stage curtain has become pure falling and rising light. Include only about 18 main streaks with tiny broken sparkling fragments, not a dense opaque wall, not a cage. A large five-point theatrical star is suggested behind her head and shoulders by five disconnected sweeping ivory-gold arcs and a few bright star points, no solid emblem or circle. At floor level one strong broad white spotlight pool with a thin red back edge anchors her to the actual battlefield; no physical platform. Around her feet, scarlet and champagne-gold star-shaped confetti lift in a slow spiral, 20 particles maximum, with a few crisp four-point glints higher up. A clean warm white followspot descends from offscreen above right and crosses the rising gold curtain, leaving her face and body extremely readable. This is celebratory revue stage lighting, ethereal and majestic rather than a magic circle or attack explosion. Color hierarchy: luminous champagne-gold curtain, ivory star strokes, restrained red glints. Keep the enemy and right half completely unaffected.
